title: Per-CELL census of EIGHT live BASKET heads never previously censused: does the basket-TRAIN screen's per-cell prediction hold on basket VALIDATION?
statistical_unit: DOMAIN (PART I 3.1). Rows never inflate n.
endpoint: y_install via the concept-free semantic_one_word readout, cell C, n_examples 4

arms.BK_KO: --knockout-cells omitted = the all-32 band knockout; the denominator
arms.HD_<h>: all nine band cells of head h; the bar source AND the admission arm

CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.nominated_on: the basket TRAIN screen (LAYER) and PR-CSI-012's basket whole-head magnitude (admission ELIGIBILITY). NEITHER uses any basket CELL data.
CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.why_these_eight: live on basket validation (|E|/bar >= 1.5 on the S-311 rule applied to PR-CSI-012's SINGLE_<h> arms, ci95 excluding 0) AND never cell-censused

EXCLUDED_already_cell_mapped.why: PR-CSI-014 measured head 2's cells and PR-CSI-015 measured 17/19/23's. Counting a known outcome as a fresh draw is selection on data already read -- the same exclusion PR-CSI-018 applied to 17/19/23 on button.

CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.⚠ WHY_NOT_THE_SCREEN_TOP_8: the four never-censused heads of the screen's top-8 (6, 13, 24, 28) predict {L9, L10, L10, L11}: heads 13 and 24 COLLIDE on L10, giving 12 distinct assignments and a permutation floor of 0.0833 > alpha. THAT FAMILY COULD NOT CERTIFY ON ANY OUTCOME (S-347). The pool was widened before any cell of any head here was measured.

⚠ PREDICTION_ALREADY_TESTED_ON_BUTTON.why_it_matters: the screen artefact is the SAME frozen file, so for these three this is a REPLICATION on a different population, not an independent draw. It is legitimate -- the prior is 'the screen is right', which is the hypothesis -- but it is a prior and it is named here rather than discovered afterwards.

CANDIDATE_PROVENANCE.⚠ HEAD_18_PREDICTS_L14: the band-edge rival. PR-CSI-018 excluded head 16 for this, correctly, where a small set could not be told from top-of-band bias. Here the eight predictions span SIX distinct layers, so the spanning rule and the permutation p both bite. Head 18 is INCLUDED and this rule is frozen BEFORE any cell is measured; dropping it after seeing the composition would be post-hoc selection.

SCREEN_PREDICTIONS_ON_RECORD_BEFORE_THIS.RE_DERIVED_BY_THIS_SCRIPT: yes -- from AtP_by_cell, not copied from any entry

PRIMARY.statistic: M = number of ADMITTED heads whose argmax band layer by |E| equals that head's frozen screen-predicted layer
PRIMARY.null: the screen's per-cell prediction is unrelated to the basket depth profile
PRIMARY.conditional: the same over ADMITTED heads whose predicted layer is unique among the admitted set

permutation.space: distinct assignments of the prediction MULTISET to the admitted heads

PRIMARY.SUCCESS: the WEAKEST of the three p-values <= 0.05 AND the spanning rule satisfied
PRIMARY.SPANNING_RULE: the MATCHING heads must not all share one band layer, or CANNOT ANSWER whatever the p-values say
PRIMARY.HOW_THE_CLAIM_MUST_BE_STATED: with the WEAKEST of the three, each named. Quoting the binomial alone is FORBIDDEN.

SECONDARY_PREREGISTERED.why: the five heads whose predictions have NEVER been tested at cell level on any codeword. Reported ALONGSIDE the primary, never INSTEAD of it.
SECONDARY_PREREGISTERED.⛔ NOT_A_FALLBACK: if the PRIMARY fails and the SECONDARY passes, the family has FAILED. The secondary exists to show the result does not REST on the three replication heads, not to rescue it.

⛔ NO_POST_HOC_SHARPNESS_SUBSETTING.rule: the margins are frozen per head HERE precisely so that a margin-restricted subset reported after the read can be recognised as one. Reporting any such subset -- as the result, as a rescue of a null, or as a qualification of a positive -- IS FORBIDDEN.

ADMISSION.rule: head h is ADMITTED iff its whole-head arm HD_<h> has a ci95 excluding 0 AND |E(HD_<h>)| >= 1.5 x bar(h)
ADMISSION.COMPUTED_FROM: the whole-head arm ALONE, never from the cells
ADMISSION.A_DROPPED_HEAD_IS_NOT_A_MISS: it leaves K and is reported with its measured power
ADMISSION.EXPECTED: all eight are expected to be admitted -- S-347 measured their |E|/bar on PR-CSI-012's arms at 2.49 / 2.33 / 2.13 / 2.07 / 1.92 / 1.92 / 1.84 / 1.80 (heads 6, 18, 10, 21, 4, 11, 13, 27). Heads 27 and 13 are the THIN ones.
ADMISSION.⚠ THESE_ARE_EXPECTATIONS_NOT_THE_VERDICT: they come from PR-CSI-012's arms; this family recomputes admission from its OWN HD_<h> arms by the S-311 rule.
ADMISSION.✅ LOSING_A_THIN_HEAD_MAKES_THIS_FAMILY_S: heads 13 and 27 are the two that COLLIDE on L10. Dropping either breaks the tie and raises K_unique from 4 to 5, raising P(certify | q=0.83) from 0.8563 to 0.9578 (S-348). PR-CSI-018 had the OPPOSITE exposure: losing either of its two unique-layer heads was fatal.

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.method: the S-311 RULE, computed at read time from this family's own HD_<h> arms

BAR_IS_A_RULE.rule: bar(h) = z * SD(per-domain paired delta of HD_<h> minus the base arm, ddof=1) / sqrt(n_domains)
BAR_IS_A_RULE.DDOF_IS_PINNED: S-318 verified ddof=1 reproduces published bars exactly
BAR_IS_A_RULE.WHY_NOT_A_NUMBER: a bar must come from the family it judges

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.⚠ NOT_HELD_OUT: THE SCREEN IS basket TRAIN AND THIS CENSUS IS basket VALIDATION, so the LAYER is held out on SPLIT ONLY -- **NOT on codeword**. PR-CSI-018 was held out on BOTH (a basket screen predicting BUTTON cells), so D39's framing is STRONGER than anything this family can claim and must not be carried over to it. The HEAD SET is chosen using PR-CSI-012's basket validation magnitudes, i.e. the SAME split this family reads -- the firewall is that liveness is a WHOLE-HEAD property while the test is WHICH CELL within a head, and admission is computed from the HD_<h> arm alone, never the cells.
DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.NOT_THE_PRIMARY: the bar governs the depth map's CLEARS/does-not-clear; the PRIMARY is argmax agreement and does not use the bar

POWER_BY_EXACT_ENUMERATION.why_exact: the statistic is COMBINATORIAL -- the outcome is which heads match, 2^K patterns -- so P(certify) is an exact sum. No effect size, no variance, no correlation to assume. S-340 is why this matters: PR-CSI-019's feasibility was computed at an assumed correlation exceeding all 60 measured arms, and the honest number was 3x worse.
POWER_BY_EXACT_ENUMERATION.⚠ THE_ONE_ASSUMPTION: heads match INDEPENDENTLY with probability q. Positive correlation across heads would widen the true spread and make every number below OPTIMISTIC.
POWER_BY_EXACT_ENUMERATION.TYPE_I_IS_CONSERVATIVE: P(certify | q = 1/9) is far below alpha, the price of gating on the weakest of three. A NULL from this family is therefore WEAK evidence against the screen, not strong.
POWER_BY_EXACT_ENUMERATION.⚠ POWERED_FOR_A_STRONG_SCREEN_ONLY: at q = 0.33 power is ~0.05. This family can confirm a screen that works; it CANNOT distinguish a mediocre screen from a useless one.
POWER_BY_EXACT_ENUMERATION.STRUCTURAL_RULE_RECORDED_BEFORE_THE_READ: m <= 4 never certifies; m = 5 in 28 of 56 subsets; m = 6 in 22 of 28; m >= 7 always. The failing 6-patterns all miss TWO of the four unique-layer heads (10:L12, 11:L8, 18:L14, 21:L6), so AT m = 6 THE FAMILY CERTIFIES IFF AT MOST ONE UNIQUE-LAYER HEAD IS MISSED.

DOSE_EXPECTATION.STATUS: MEASURED (S-299, S-306, S-317, and S-335 on 62 arms)
DOSE_EXPECTATION.⚠ BLIND_AS_AN_IDENTITY: all 72 cell arms expect 224 and all 8 HD_ arms plus BK_KO expect 2016, so the dose cannot distinguish arms within either group. Identity MUST come from each run's own knockout_cells (S-292/S-310).

population.test_note: TEST is NEVER touched. S-314: it is ALSO already spent and selection-contaminated, so it is not an axis even in principle.

NO_RANK_TEST: this family carries no control pool and no rank; the rank tooling must refuse it

VOID_CONDITIONS.1: any arm's recorded knockout_cells differs from cell_sets
VOID_CONDITIONS.3: BK_KO records a cell list (it must record NONE)
VOID_CONDITIONS.5: the screen artefact's md5 differs from artifact_md5_at_freeze
VOID_CONDITIONS.6: a tie for the argmax on any admitted head -- CANNOT ANSWER, M and p NOT computed
VOID_CONDITIONS.7: more than one run directory for any arm (S-261/S-334)
VOID_CONDITIONS.8: any HD_<h> arm differs from its whole_head_REFERENCE by more than void_tolerance. ENFORCED by scripts/dcs_csi_head_census.py (S-323), under the FAMILY-NEUTRAL key (S-349)

WHAT_THIS_CANNOT_ANSWER: whether the screen predicts for heads that are NULL on basket -- this family admits only live ones, by construction
anything about the OTHER 24 heads, or about cells outside band 6-14
anything about the SOURCE of the effect (S-316/AM-40 stand; the mass instrument's criterion licenses a REFUTATION reading only, S-337/S-343)
whether the screen's sub-argmax ORDERING transfers -- S-307 measured that it does not
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_POSITIVE: the binomial p alone -- the claim is the WEAKEST of the three, each named
that this is held out on codeword -- IT IS NOT. Split only. D39 is the cross-codeword result; this is not, and conflating them would overstate both
'cell (L, h) is the writer' -- there is STILL no control family of ARBITRARY cells anywhere in this sprint. This is NECESSITY, rung 1 of AM-34's ladder
that the screen is a validated cell selector IN GENERAL -- eight heads, every one chosen BECAUSE it was live on basket
any margin-restricted subset of the eight
that D37 is superseded -- D37 is descriptive and stands; this ADDS a preregistered p
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_NULL: that the screen is useless -- type I here is far below alpha and power at a MEDIOCRE screen (q = 0.33) is ~0.05, so a null is WEAK evidence against it
that D39 is withdrawn -- D39 stands on its own preregistered read of button
that D37 is withdrawn -- D37 is descriptive and rests on its own arms
that the basket depth structure is absent -- D36/D37 measured it directly
SELECTION_RE_ENTERS_WHEN: any head is added, dropped or re-ordered after an arm has run, or if the SECONDARY is reported instead of the PRIMARY
